v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: All ye nations * shout unto God with the voice of joy.

text.la: Inténde * voci oratiónis meæ, Rex meus et Deus meus.
text.en: Hearken to the voice * of my prayer, O my King and my God.

text.la: Deus maiestátis * intónuit: afférte glóriam nómini eius.
text.en: The God of majesty * hath thundered, ascribe to the Lord glory to his name.

text.la: Laudámus nomen tuum * ínclitum, Deus noster.
text.en: O God of majesty, * we praise thy glorious name.
O praise the Lord, * all ye nations. ‡

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: Benedíctus * Dóminus Deus Israël, quia visitávit et liberávit nos.
text.en: Blessed be the Lord * the God of Israel, because he has visited and redeemed his people.

text.la: Deus, cuius providéntia in sui dispositióne non fállitur: te súpplices exorámus; ut nóxia cuncta submóveas, et ómnia nobis profutúra concédas.
text.en: O God, Whose never-failing Providence ordereth all things both in heaven and earth, we humbly beseech thee to put away from us all hurtful things, and to give us those things which be profitable for us.

text.la: Símile est regnum cælórum hómini negotiatóri quærénti bonas margarítas: invénta una pretiósa, dedit ómnia sua, et comparávit eam.
text.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchantman seeking goodly pearls, who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Indulgéntiam nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine, beáta Christína Virgo et Martyr implóret: quæ tibi grata semper éxstitit, et mérito castitátis, et tuæ professióne virtútis.
text.en: O Lord, we pray thee, that thy blessed handmaiden and witness Christina in whom Thou hast ever been well pleased, because of her worthy maidenhood and her mighty showing-forth of thy power, may entreat thy pardon on our behalf.

office.title: Feria secunda infra Hebd VII post Octavam Pentecostes
